project_type: Monorepo (npm workspaces) - React SPA frontend + Express backend. Arabic-RTL educational platform.
build_system: npm workspaces, Vite for frontend, tsc for type-checking
test_framework: No test runner configured in frontend package.json
verification_instructions: 1. Verify TypeScript compiles cleanly (no npm available - use AST/grep validation). 2. Verify CSS file is syntactically valid (balanced braces, no typos). 3. Verify main.tsx imports the new file last.
setup_instructions: npm install (but INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - not possible)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no Docker pull, no external HTTP. TypeScript compiler not available. Validation must be AST-based or grep-based.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Do NOT modify .tsx files unless absolutely necessary.
key_patterns: CSS uses design tokens from tokens.css (--surface-1, --border, --text, --accent, etc). stitch-canonical.css uses !important extensively. Components use BEM-like naming (oasis-widget__panel, dash-customizer-modal). Dark theme is default ([data-theme='dark']), light is opt-in.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - 25 CSS files loaded in cascade order via main.tsx. frontend/src/components/ - React components. frontend/src/stores/ - zustand stores.
